records.text: Brooklyn Beckham said his mother called him evil during the wedding because he and Nicola Peltz seated their nannies at their table while both sets of parents had adjacent tables.
records.speaker: Brooklyn Beckham

appearances.snippet: He goes on, during the wedding, my mom went so far as to call me evil because Nicola (Nicola Peltz) and I chose to include my nanny Sandra (Brooklyn Beckham's nanny; surname unverified) and Nicola (Nicola Peltz)'s nanny, that's two grandparents, at our table because they both didn't have their husbands. Both of our parents had their own table. ... equally adjacent to ours

verification.notes: The full contemporaneous reproduction of Beckham's Instagram statement says his mother called him evil over seating the two nannies while both sets of parents had adjacent tables. This verifies the quoted post; the private event is not independently adjudicated.

sources.title: Brooklyn Beckham’s bombshell statement in full as he hits out at ‘controlling’ parents
